target.title: fix(agents): render identity name in runtime prompt
target.body:
Restored replacement for #94437 after the fork/head repository was recreated.

## Summary
- resolve the active `agents.list[].identity.name` into system prompt runtime metadata
- keep the technical slot id stable as `agent=<id>`
- render a different configured identity as `agentName=<identity>`
- preserve current stable cron session rendering while rebasing onto current `main`
- add focused coverage for prompt params, runtime rendering, and CLI prompt assembly

Fixes #81269.

## What Problem This Solves
Runtime prompt metadata previously only exposed the technical agent slot id, so configured identities could still drift back toward generic ids such as `main`. This PR keeps the stable technical id for existing consumers while exposing the configured display identity separately as `agentName=<identity>`.

## User Impact
Configured agent identities can be reflected in the runtime prompt without changing the existing `agent=<id>` contract used for session/debug context.

## Evidence
Latest local verification on head `18e658ab99afcd703b5672b6054c29ae11e312fd`:

```text
oxfmt --check src/agents/system-prompt.ts src/agents/system-prompt-params.ts src/agents/system-prompt.test.ts src/agents/system-prompt-params.test.ts src/agents/cli-runner/helpers.system-prompt.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.

vitest run src/agents/system-prompt.test.ts src/agents/system-prompt-params.test.ts src/agents/cli-runner/helpers.system-prompt.test.ts --config test/vitest/vitest.agents.config.ts
Test Files  2 passed (2)
Tests  20 passed (20)

vitest run src/agents/cli-runner/helpers.system-prompt.test.ts
Test Files  2 passed (2)
Tests  22 passed (22)

git diff --check
# no output
```

Latest-head terminal proof for the final runtime shape:

```text
node --import tsx -e 'import { buildSystemPromptParams } from "./src/agents/system-prompt-params.ts"; import { buildRuntimeLine } from "./src/agents/system-prompt.ts"; const { runtimeInfo } = buildSystemPromptParams({ config: { agents: { list: [{ id: "Team Ops", identity: { name: "Ops Navigator" } }] } }, agentId: "team-ops", runtime: { host: "host", os: "darwin", arch: "arm64", node: process.version, model: "test-model" } }); console.log(buildRuntimeLine(runtimeInfo));'
Runtime: agent=team-ops | agentName=Ops Navigator | host=host | os=darwin (arm64) | node=v25.9.0 | model=test-model | thinking=off
```

Observed result after fix: The technical id remains in `agent=team-ops`; the configured identity is rendered as `agentName=Ops Navigator` only when it differs from the id. Focused tests also cover identity-name resolution, prompt rendering, and CLI prompt assembly.

## Not Tested
A live agent conversation was not started in this environment; the focused prompt construction and CLI assembly paths exercise the affected runtime prompt output.

---
Reopened after active-PR limit cleanup. Supersedes closed PR #94397.
